definition.branch_derivation: du_q/dlambda=A_q; the constant b_q has zero work contribution
definition.load_parameterization: F(lambda)=lambda*F_ref, as used by the frozen runtime load path
definition.transition_policy: split each load interval at every observed inactive/active or active/inactive transition; use the branch valid on each subinterval

residual_gate.definition: maximum recorded nonlinear free residual relative to reference load norm

oracle.construction: [K_ff+k_p*c_f*c_f^T]u_f=lambda*f_f-k_p*g0*c_f on active branches; K_ff*u_f=lambda*f_f on inactive branches
oracle.plan: independent dense linear-elastic K plus independently constructed contact row and active-set branch work integration
shared_limitations: element K kernel may be shared with runtime assembly
contact row, gap equation, dense solve and work integration are independent of runtime active/contact assembly

claim_policy.wording: Bounded frictionless penalty contact, small-sliding node-to-triangle static/quasi-static, tested on the documented TET4 geometries and penalty range.

cross_check.analytic_method: active-set branchwise exact integral using only F_ref^T*A_q; no b_q term
cross_check.numerical_method: independent pointwise equilibrium solves sampled by numerical quadrature; state transitions detected and bracketed numerically; quadrature does not call analytic A_q/b_q work formula

energy.branch_derivation: du_q/dlambda=A_q; the constant b_q has zero work contribution
energy.load_parameterization: F(lambda)=lambda*F_ref, as used by the frozen runtime load path
energy.transition_policy: split each load interval at every observed inactive/active or active/inactive transition; use the branch valid on each subinterval

final_gap.definition: absolute final normal gap for the active final state

force_balance.definition: maximum recorded nonlinear free residual relative to reference load norm

max_penetration.definition: max over all recorded load steps of max(-gap,0)

mesh_refinement.definition: two-level contact force, displacement, penetration and reaction characterization
mesh_refinement.promotion_gate: none; finite, converged, traceable observations required

normal_force.comparison: strictly positive contact-force norm and non-tensile normal sign
normal_force.definition: final contact force is compressive along the frozen master normal

penalty_sensitivity.definition: penetration is non-increasing over the declared penalty sequence; every solve converges and residuals are finite

replay.comparison: exact arrays and identical status; semantic digest equality

limitations: initial small-sliding search with frozen normal and face
linear elastic isotropic TET4 solids only
no general finite sliding or self-contact
no augmented Lagrangian, mortar, impact, dynamic, MPI or nonlinear-material contact claim
penalty values are bounded tested values, not universal recommendations

failure_cases.observed_message: contact master must reference an existing node.

failure_cases.name: invalid slave node
failure_cases.observed_message: contact slave must reference an existing node.

failure_cases.name: zero penalty
failure_cases.observed_message: Penalty contact stiffness must be finite and positive.

failure_cases.name: negative penalty
failure_cases.observed_message: Penalty contact stiffness must be finite and positive.

failure_cases.name: invalid triangle
failure_cases.observed_message: Contact master triangle has a zero or non-finite area.

failure_cases.name: unsupported contact mode
failure_cases.observed_message: Nonlinear contact requires explicit contact_mode='penalty'; the historical active-set solver is not silently reused.

failure_cases.name: unsupported friction request
failure_cases.observed_message: The common nonlinear contact path is frictionless only.

failure_cases.name: malformed contact pair
failure_cases.observed_message: A frictionless contact needs exactly three master nodes.
